# Motor-Oid

> The honest vehicle marketplace. AI-powered tools for buyers and sellers. No middleman. No portal fees. Just transparency.

## What Motor-Oid Does

Motor-Oid is a UK vehicle marketplace built on honesty and equal power.

**For buyers:** Spanner Jack — a fierce AI advisor that analyses used vehicles before you buy. Reads listings, spots red flags, checks MOT history, values the vehicle, asks the questions a mechanic would ask. Free forever. Anonymous — we see a question, not a person.

**For sellers:** The Walkround — film a 2-minute walkaround of your vehicle, Spanner Jack reads the video, builds a professional listing page with honest condition report, specs, and valuation. QR code goes on the windscreen. Buyers call you direct. No middleman. No portal fees.

**For operators (Spicy Hustlers):** A micro-agency model. Buy a credit bundle, film vehicles for sellers at £25 a vehicle, keep the margin. Your own hamlet page. Earn kudos. Build a reputation.

## Pricing

- List a vehicle: £15 (Villager member) / £25 (non-member)
- Villager membership: £3/month (Patreon)
- Founder membership: £15/month (Patreon) — own hamlet, 10 passes/month to gift
- Operator bundles: 5 credits £50 / 10 credits £80 / 20 credits £140

## The Village

Motor-Oid is built around a village structure — garages, mechanics, and trusted sellers have hamlet pages. Members earn kudos. Founders earn their way up by contributing, not just paying.

## Pages

- [Home](https://motor-oid.co.uk/): Spanner Jack buyer tools + The Walkround seller flow
- [Sell — The Walkround](https://motor-oid.co.uk/sell): Film your vehicle → AI listing → QR code → live in minutes
- [Story](https://motor-oid.co.uk/story): Why Motor-Oid exists — "The game was rigged. Now you're armed."
- [Dealers](https://motor-oid.co.uk/dealers): Live dealer directory with service filters
- [Dealer join](https://motor-oid.co.uk/dealers/join): Dealer onboarding
- [Spicy Hustler — Operators](https://motor-oid.co.uk/operators/join): Become a mobile vehicle listing agent
- [Operator dashboard](https://motor-oid.co.uk/operators/dashboard): Credit balance, hamlet link, workflow guide
- [Hamlet directory](https://motor-oid.co.uk/hamlet): Village pages for garages and mechanics
- [GR Autos — Hamlet #001](https://motor-oid.co.uk/hamlet/gr-autos): Founding Garage — Gary & Glyn Rushent, Yate, Bristol

## Philosophy

Not the middleman — just transparency. Bad actors self-select out when they know the honest condition report is on the windscreen. Equal power for buyer and seller.

Spanner Jack doesn't take a cut of your sale. Motor-Oid doesn't own your listing. Your page is yours.

All searches are anonymous. We see a question, not a person.
